messages:
Priya Nair: Heads up, CI is showing weirdly low p95 for int8 sweeps, looks like concurrency counts are doubled in the dashboard.
Jon Tse: saw that too. dashboards show ~2x QPS in multiple runs.
Aisha Gomez: I think the metrics-collector remap change from last week might be double-counting 'runner_id' vs 'runner' labels.
Priya Nair: @Jon can you grab the raw prometheus export? I want to see the label sets and whether relabeling collapsed them.
Jon Tse: grabbed export and uploaded to CI artifacts: http://ci-artifacts/reports/1818123456/prom.csv
Jon Tse: examples from the export:
```
labels: {runner="r1", model="m-gptq", batch=32}
value: 120.0
labels: {runner="r1", model="m-gptq", runner_id="r1"}
value: 240.0
```
Mark Liu: aha - metrics-mapper introduced runner_id but didn't remove the old 'runner' label, so prometheus shows two distinct timeseries. That would inflate aggregated QPS if our dashboard sums across label combos.
Aisha Gomez: that explains the doubled throughput spikes during concurrency sweeps. We should either normalize labels at scrape or dedupe on ingest.
Priya Nair: quick mitigation: patch metrics-mapper to drop the legacy 'runner' when runner_id exists. Minimal change:
```
# metrics_mapper.py
if 'runner_id' in labels:
    labels.pop('runner', None)
```
Jon Tse: spun a sandbox runner with that change, re-ran a small sweep locally — p95 and qps look consistent now. Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/metrics/pull/498
metrics-bot: CI queued for metrics mapping change (job: metrics-unit-tests) :gear:
Priya Nair: good. Also, historical dashboards will be noisy until we backfill or add a migration. Can we add a short note on the dashboard explaining the schema change?
Mark Liu: will do. Also kicking a backfill job: `python tools/backfill_metrics.py --from 2025-08-01 --to 2025-08-04`
Aisha Gomez: for long term, let's add a CI assertion: fail if a metrics payload contains both 'runner' and 'runner_id' labels. Prevents reintroducing the bug.
Jon Tse: agreed — adding a unit test in metrics/tests/test_label_schema.py and a relabel sanity check in the aggregator.
Priya Nair: nice. Once CI is green, rerun the full concurrency sweep and post the new plots here. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: concurrency-sweep job started: sweep/2025-08-04-17:02 (job id sweep-775)
Jon Tse: new sweep finished, p95 stabilizes at expected level, uploaded plot: http://ci-artifacts/reports/1818123456/p95-plot.png
Priya Nair: thanks everyone — marking this resolved in the triage board and adding the label-schema test to the next sprint. :tada:
